name: Boglurker
bio: Crawled out of the marsh for the noise and stayed for the shooting. Smells exactly as you fear.
notes: New model 2026-11-25 (owner: "many are replacements for what we currently have"; id, name and place kept, as Thornweaver's and Anoobys's swaps). Boglurker's model until 2026-11-25 ("A humanoid crocodile wearing a heavy", Meshy Community CC0) no longer ships (a community model, not the owner's: owner, 2026-11-25, only the owner's own retired models stay as MapMaker figures). Drive intake of 2026-11-25 ("boglurker game ready", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Licence: Meshy, owned: the owner's own Meshy model (owner, 2026-11-25: "all are the owner's own Meshy creations"; standing rule since 2026-11-22).
